title: Character evaluated at the zero vector
statement: Fix an integer $k \ge 1$ and let $\omega_k = e^{2\pi i/k}$. For any $s \in \mathbb{Z}_k^n$, the Fourier character $\chi_s(x) = \omega_k^{s \cdot x}$ satisfies $\chi_s(0) = 1$, where $0$ denotes the zero vector of $\mathbb{Z}_k^n$.
hypotheses_covered: s an arbitrary vector in Z_k^n
evaluation point is the zero vector
